statement: Lambda lists NVIDIA H100 SXM on-demand cloud capacity at $4.29 per GPU-hour for a single GPU.
why: Published rental rates give a current reference level for the cost of renting prior-generation Nvidia capacity.

impact.mechanism: Listed rental rates are a display-only price level with no stated baseline or change, so they set context rather than direction.

confidence.basis: Vendor's own public price page, but a single provider and no baseline for comparison.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 6.69 -> 4.29 (tol 1%); sources: Lambda
